name: Graphviz (dot)
layout: layered, a four-pass algorithm building on Sugiyama et al.
what it gets right: the reference layered layout; dot is the ancestor of dagre

name: PlantUML
licence: GPL (LGPL, Apache, EPL and MIT builds too)
layout: Graphviz by default; also Smetana (Graphviz in Java) and ELK
what it gets right: every UML diagram from text; long the default in enterprise docs

name: D2
layout: dagre, ELK and TALA (TALA released with D2 when Terrastruct wound down in 2026)
what it gets right: a modern syntax designed after Mermaid and PlantUML; three engines to choose from

name: Pikchr
layout: none: the author places things, as in PIC
what it gets right: safe for internet-facing apps; one C file; made for Markdown fences

name: ELK
layout: a collection of algorithms, layered among them
what it gets right: positions only, no drawing; Mermaid's default layout since 12.0

name: dagre
layout: layered, after Gansner et al.: network simplex ranks, crossing reduction, Brandes-Koepf coordinates
what it gets right: small and client-side; Mermaid's layout for a decade

name: Kroki
layout: none of its own: it calls the tools
what it gets right: one HTTP API for about thirty diagram languages

name: mermaid-ascii
what it gets right: Mermaid in the terminal; the base of beautiful-mermaid's ASCII mode
